newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - ITT Corp lowered to hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - ITT Corp lowered to hold.

text.p: Credit Lyonnais Securities analyst David Loeb said he had downgraded ITT Corp from buy to hold based on his unfavorable view of the company's strategy to avert being taken over by Hilton Hotels Corp.

-- said believes ITT may have come up with a strong but potentially self-destructive takeover defense that could not only repel Hilton but render ITT an unattractive takeover candidate for any company.

-- said value of ITT is now uncertain and he could not value it until getting more information about potential asset sales and use of proceeds, adding there was a risk the company could face shareholder lawsuits.
-- ITT gained 5/8 to 58-5/8 in morning trade.
